hsbc.scope: Personal US stock trading, including the Trade25 tariff; stock quantity is independent of fee waivers.

usmart.scope: Hong Kong fractional-stock trading; the purchase minimum is not applied as a one-dollar minimum liquidation value.

chiefMonthly.scope: Fractional monthly investment: subtract charges from each gross contribution, then round allocated shares down; subsequent sales use ordinary stock tariffs.

excluded: HSBC Taiwan or Singapore trading rules
Treating IBKR's one-dollar marketing example as a universal minimum despite its published 0.75-dollar commission example
